# Modern Flash

> SVG-based Flash animation engine, GSAP ActionScript choreography, and prompt-driven animation studio for Next.js and WordPress.

## Level 1: Integrator & Consumer
- [Project Overview](README.md): Flash animation engine and prompt studio scope.
- [Dual-Ecosystem Integration](docs/dual-ecosystem-integration.md): Step-by-step guides for Next.js and WordPress setups.
- [Docker Distribution Specification](docs/docker-distribution.md): Public Docker Hub registry, multi-platform buildx compilation, and community distribution.

## Level 2: Application Engineer
- [Flagship Web Application](docs/flagship-web-app.md): Public Next.js 15 web app, zero-scroll viewport geometry, Google Cloud VM deployment, and Firebase suite integration.
- [Docker Harness Specification](docs/docker-harness.md): Container architecture, port configuration, and operational commands.

## Level 3: Systems & Deep Infrastructure ("The Geek Tier")
- [Hybrid Package Architecture](docs/hybrid-package-architecture.md): Single-repository dual-target architecture for NPM and WordPress.
- [Virtual Machine Deployment](docs/vm-deployment.md): Google Cloud VM topology, Caddy reverse proxy, systemd services, Unix domain sockets, and MariaDB routing.
- [Agentic Control Surface](docs/agentic-control-surface.md): Baseline agentic controls and verification tooling.
- [Agent Directives](AGENTS.md): Autonomous agent pairing contracts and verification baselines.
